text:
<notes>This is the first round. We need to understand how Gemma-2-9B responds to word problems without any guidance. The goal is to find an instruction that encourages a concise, direct answer while minimizing the activation of the arithmetic-related parts of the model. A good starting point might be to encourage the model to focus on the "what" of the answer, rather than any potential reasoning process.</notes>
<instruction>Think of the answer to this problem as a single, concrete fact.  What is that fact? </instruction>
